title.narrative: African Union Sports Council Region 5 – Regional Conference on Developing a Comprehensive Vision of Inclusive Access for All, Physical Education and Physical Activity

description.narrative: PEISA, in collaboration with AUSC Region 5, proposes hosting a Regional Physical Education and Sport Conference in Lesotho. Aligned with UNESCO's priorities, the conference aims to address MINEPS policy areas, particularly focusing on inclusive access to sports and physical education. The Fit-for-Life objective, emphasizing values education through sport, is central. The project targets government officials, educational institutions, and stakeholders from Region 5 countries. It aligns with UNESCO's objectives for Africa, youth and gender equality, LDC participation, and the priorities outlined for 2024-2025. The conference, hosted by NUL, will involve around 80 participants and deliver key documents, focusing on topics relevant to UNESCO's goals.
